profiles.name: Performance
profiles.description: 8-chunk render distance, no shaders or distant terrain renderer.
profiles.recommendation: Start here on Steam Deck, older laptops, or integrated graphics.

profiles.name: Distant Horizons
profiles.description: Distant terrain and Complementary Reimagined shaders.
profiles.recommendation: The default choice for shaders on a dedicated GPU.

profiles.name: Distant Horizons · Vulkan
profiles.description: Distant terrain and Complementary Reimagined on Minecraft’s experimental Vulkan renderer.
profiles.recommendation: Try this if your GPU supports Vulkan and you want to test the experimental renderer.

profiles.name: Voxy
profiles.description: Voxy builds a distant view from chunks you explore. Includes Complementary Reimagined shaders.
profiles.recommendation: Choose this if you have OpenGL 4.6 and want Voxy instead of Distant Horizons.
